title: BroodMinder Weight Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Beehive telemetry (`beehive:reading`), coop door (`chickencoop:door`), egg counts (`egg:count`), livestock tags (`livestock:tag`), feed level (`feed:level`), pasture sensors (`pasture:sensor`), trail cams (`trailcam:detection`).
app: Homestead sensors — connected beehive scale/temperature/sound, automatic chicken-coop door, egg counter, livestock GPS/health tags, feed-silo level, and pasture soil sensors — via MQTT and LoRaWAN gateways.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=broodminder:weight
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(hive_id) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many BroodMinder weight events land each day and how many distinct hive values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest BroodMinder weight records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct hive values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It estimates how much BroodMinder weight activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
